title: Repair a push
prompt: heap is a valid min-heap stored in an array. Add value to it so that it is still a valid min-heap. Put the value at the end and sift it up.
hints: In the failing check, the new value has to travel more than one level. How many times does the starter compare it with a parent?
Repeat the comparison from the new position until the parent is not larger, or the value reaches index 0.
Turn the if into a loop: while index > 0 and the parent is larger, swap and set index to the parent's index.

rules.name: sort
rules.message: Sift the value up yourself. Do not call sort.

checks: (() => { const heap: number[] = []; for (const value of [5, 9, 1, 8, 2, 7, 3]) heapPush(heap, value); return __isHeap(heap) && heap.length === 7 && heap[0] === 1; })()
checkLabels: 0 rises from the bottom to the root in two swaps.
Adding to an empty heap gives one element.
A large value stays at the end.
A value equal to its parent stops below it.
Seven pushes leave a valid heap with 1 at the root.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Compares with one parent and stops, so the value rises one level at most.
Sorts the whole array on every push, which costs far more than one path.

feedback: Follow the new value by hand in the failing check. After one swap, is its new parent still larger?
